recent.text: Blazers lead 101-92 after three quarters . Avdija up to 29 points. Maxey leads the Sixers with 22 points.

recent.text: After three: Blazers 101, Sixers 92. Blazers pulled ahead in the third quarter and Dominick Barlow played the last minute or so in real pain after taking a tough fall. Sixers are 8-23 on threes compared to a whopping 16-35 for Portland.
recent.author: Adam Aaronson

recent.text: Halftime: Blazers 69, Sixers 69. LeBron James caps off arguably his best half as a Sixer by once again pump-faking, side-stepping and cashing out from the corner. He has 16-3-3. Jaylen Brown leads the way with 19 points on 8-10 FG. Six assists for VJ Edgecombe.
recent.author: Adam Aaronson
